Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a critical error in data aggregation and verification. After performing multiple "scroll_down" actions to review the list of articles, the agent prematurely concluded that all 97 articles had .ps versions available. This conclusion was based on the assumption that the presence of an "[other]" link in the metadata implies a .ps file, which is a logical fallacy (the "other" link could be for HTML, source code, or other formats). Furthermore, the agent failed to actually extract or verify the specific file extensions for each article, instead making a blanket assumption that led to an incorrect final count. This mirrors the error pattern in Example 8 (Case #73), where an agent reported a count that did not align with the ground truth due to incomplete exploration or oversight in verifying the specific criteria (in this case, verifying the actual file format rather than just the existence of an "other" link).
